summary: The early sky steps already show later work (sun, trunks, dabbed foliage) plus a filter-like blur, and several steps jump from a flat block-in to finished detail (bark, leaves, wing, body, feet) with colors the named paint can't make. Persistent picture defects (lumps where the feet go, a speckled fringe round the bird) repeat across many steps, and the words often defer to 'what the after picture shows' instead of naming paint and place.
